canonical_comparison.coverage_contract: All four objectives cover training transitions 0 through 79. Reset and rollout each include target states 1 through 80 exactly once; they differ intentionally only in how long model-generated feedback survives before truth is reintroduced.

solver_loss_weighting.field_weighting: natural mixed inner(v,h,S,Qv,Qc,Qr) sum; no extra block scaling
solver_loss_weighting.per_target_outer_weight: 1/80 for each target n=1,...,80 in both reset and rollout
solver_loss_weighting.state_metric: squared mixed L2 norm integral_Omega inner(error,error) dx_GLL

data_access_contract.evaluation: State 80 initializes held-out deployment; target states 81 through 160 are available only after fitting.
data_access_contract.fitting: Only states 0 through 80 may be loaded or used by fitting objectives, fitted normalization, scans, gradients, HVPs, or stopping decisions.

rejected_32x32_dt400.disposition: diagnostic evidence only; forbidden as Test 1B truth or training data

stable_32x32_dt100.disposition: not selected for the first Test 1B
stable_32x32_dt100.reason: c0 sensitivity was approximately one order of magnitude weaker; r^s scaling and the smooth flow left newly available high modes weakly populated

selection_status: scientifically selected; gate 1 not yet executed
